A1: ACCEPT Inspected API 308efaa9b (test-only: _crsp_cohort_fixtures.py and test_crsp_cohort.py) at f10fd982c. cohort_case now filters membership/returns/delists of database_rows() to permno in {1, DELISTED=8} and feeds that same filtered dict to both FakeDatabase/run_vendor (real keys, real encryption) and partition_rows, so case.rows is exactly what was encrypted. The fleet line runs test_real_encrypted_cohort_keeps_lineage..., which now asserts the returns permnos equal {1, 8}. Negative read from source: database_rows() is study_rows(FINAL_END) (returns for permnos 1..8) plus the ineligible, late and straddling securities, so cutting the filter yields an 11-permno returns set and that assertion fails; the fleet line therefore detects a fixture that goes back to encrypting the full study. Foreign exclusion is decided by the same test: source rows hold securities 1 and 8, result securities == 1, and every decrypted derived row equals case.rows filtered to permno 1 (calendar whole). Terminal evidence: delists == {8} and permno 8's DD/Y terminal returns row survives the filter. Final partition refusal (test_final_bundle_is_refused_without_a_final_key), the CRSP-006 real source-load refusal, ciphertext tamper, identity, budget and output-link refusals are all unchanged and run by the fleet line. The two file lines only pin text; the behaviour is decided by the fleet line.
A2: ACCEPT The fleet line decides the 300-second limit itself, and a real negative proves it. fleet-node-lavender post 69bc5d80 (job 704cc1c4 at API 291d000b) reads exit=2, tests=5534p/0f, coverage=100.00%, budget=over:303s/300s, so the fleet check fails a run that is over budget even when every test passes. fleet-node-colossus post 486619c7 (job 33ee64b6 at f10fd982c) reads exit=0, banner=yes, tests=5534p/0f, coverage=total=100.00%, budget=within:208s/300s. Both are posts the fleet nodes wrote themselves, and they name the failed and the corrected run. make check in libs/covenant_ml includes mypy src tests scripts, ruff and the guard. The inventory is unchanged at 5534 in both runs, and the diff removes no test function. The commits naming the task are those two API commits (a fixture and test change, then one wiki page), so no study fitting or final release is in scope. The audit re-runs the fleet line against the same budget.
